      "snippet": "Good catch — this one is not a logic bug, it’s an Android / filesystem write failure, and the error code tells us exactly which class.

What that error actually means (RCA)
You hit:
vbnetCopy codecurl: (23) Failure writing output to destination, passed 1370 returned 0

That error only happens when curl cannot write bytes to disk.
The two common causes on Termux are:
1) Out of writable space in the target filesystem (most likely)

Your screenshots show you are operating inside /sdcard/Download/.."
